title: Warm Pillowy Norwegian Bread Toast
description: A quick and easy Norwegian dish featuring toasted bread and a mix of fried grind rice, perfect for a snack or light meal. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is rich in healthy fats and whole grains.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Toast the bread slices until lightly browned and crispy.
In a separate pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and fry the grind rice until lightly toasted and fragrant.
Season the fried rice with salt and black pepper to taste.
To assemble the toast, place a toasted bread slice on a serving plate and top with a spoonful of the fried rice mixture.
If using, sprinkle fried shallots and sesame seeds over the top of the rice.
Serve the warm pillowy Norwegian bread toast immediately and enjoy.
Consider serving with a side of fresh fruit or a green salad for a balanced snack.
